series_books.title: The Courthouse Wedding Planner
series_books.subtitle: Plan a Small Civil Ceremony in Weeks, Not Months: License Steps, Guest List, Photos and a Day-Of Timeline
series_books.description:
A courthouse or city hall wedding is small, but it still has moving parts: the license, the appointment, the witnesses, what to wear, who to invite, photos on the steps and a meal afterwards.

This planner puts them in order so you can plan it in weeks, not months, and still have a day that feels like yours.

Inside:
- Is a courthouse wedding right for you: the honest trade-offs
- The marriage license, step by step, and what to check with your county clerk
- Booking the ceremony, witnesses and what happens in the room
- The small guest list, how to tell people, and what to say to hurt feelings
- Outfits, flowers, rings and photos on a small budget
- Lunch, dinner or a party later
- A countdown checklist and a day-of timeline you fill in

Rules for licenses and ceremonies differ by state and county and change; this book shows you what to ask, and your county clerk's office has the final word.

Published by Spry Labs, the makers of the Dream Wedding Builder.

series_books.title: Writing Your Wedding Vows
series_books.subtitle: Find the Words in One Evening: Prompts, Real-Sounding Examples and a Simple Shape for Promises You Can Say Out Loud
series_books.description:
You have been asked to write your own vows, and the page is still blank. This short guide gets you from blank page to vows you can say out loud without shaking, in one evening.

Inside:
- The simple four-part shape most good vows share
- Forty prompts to dig up the memories and promises that are yours
- Example vows in different voices (funny, classic, short, faith-friendly, second marriage) to show what the shape sounds like, never to copy
- How long vows should be, and how to match your partner without reading each other's
- Editing out cliches and inside jokes no one else gets
- Practising, printing and what to do if you cry
- Fill-in pages to draft, cut and finish

Published by Spry Labs, the makers of the Dream Wedding Builder.

series_books.title: The Maid of Honor Handbook
series_books.subtitle: Every Duty From the Engagement to the Last Dance, With a Shower Plan, Toast Builder and Day-Of Checklist
series_books.description:
You said yes. Now what? This handbook lays out the whole job, month by month, so you can show up for your friend without losing your mind or your budget.

Inside:
- What the role really involves, and what it does not
- Talking money early: the conversation nobody wants and everyone needs
- Helping with the dress, the details and the group chat
- Planning the shower and the bachelorette: a simple plan, a budget split and games that do not embarrass anyone
- Writing and giving the toast: a fill-in toast builder, timing and delivery
- The wedding day: an hour-by-hour checklist and an emergency kit list
- When things go wrong: clashing bridesmaids, a stressed couple, your own limits

Works for a maid of honor, matron of honor or anyone standing beside the couple.

Published by Spry Labs, the makers of the Dream Wedding Builder.
